title: Cuvee Réne
summary: Always a risk opening a random sour in the fridge. They don't last but this 9ne was grabbed in time and wow it's a wonderful lambic that was a sour before sour was a thing.
author: Greg McVerry

Category: drank-beer

Always a risk opening a random sour in the fridge. They don't last but this 9ne was grabbed in time and wow it's a wonderful lambic that was a sour before sour was a thing.
